temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated, hardworking friend who may be overcommitting himself to his job.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirms that Gary is overworking to the point of neglecting his health and is unwilling or unable to step away because of hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overcommitted and needs help, but currently resists taking a break because of his hospital workload.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Intervene by encouraging Gary to take a break and prioritize his health, possibly by trying again or finding another way to help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of discussions about work. When confronted, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked from professional obligations and needs relaxation, but he has not yet identified deeper causes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Shifts from seeing Gary's overwork as purely job-related to suspecting that there are deeper personal or complicated issues Gary is hiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is struggling with something more than ordinary hospital obligations and is reluctant to burden others with it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront Gary gently and encourage him to open up, offering nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan offers help with prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities, and Gary agrees.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork has deeper causes, but he does not yet know the specific reasons.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Learns the specific causes: Gary is dealing with new department pressures and personal challenges. Gary is also willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork stems from new department responsibilities and personal challenges; with task prioritization, delegation, and support, he can find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and work toward better balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is not as overwhelmed, and he had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary can improve with support, though he still faces challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirms that Gary is actively making efforts and that the support is helping; Gary's progress is real.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier work-life balance and is less overwhelmed than before.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control. Ethan tells Gary he is always a call away but knows Gary has got this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been progressing, but he may still see himself as an active source of support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Recognizes that Gary no longer needs active intervention and can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own; Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back and let Gary manage independently, while staying available if Gary ever needs help.
